items.headline: East Carolina hosts Rice in AAC action
items.description: Rice (1-4) at East Carolina (2-2), Oct. 10 at 4 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: East Carolina scores 6 TDs in first half to cruise past North Carolina Central 42-9
items.description: — Emory Williams threw three touchdown passes and TJ Engleman Jr. accounted for three scores, and East Carolina rolled past North Carolina Central 42-9 on Saturday.
